where: The Drowned Lamp, the moment the Farlamp burns again and the Farlamp Isles get their own dawn
mood: The relight: the isles' hymn heard in the dark's minor, then blooming into warm major as the fog lifts.
_motif_note: High on motif-farlamp.json: the family's payoff rung, the minor-to-major cadence.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor resolving to D major
a single glass bell, then a warm pulse-wave lead singing the seafaring hymn tune
gentle festive drums with soft snare joining later
emotional swelling release, warm and a touch bittersweet, a drowned lighthouse lit again and fog lifting from the sea

sections.name: The Dark Water
sections.text: {hushed: a single glass bell states the opening of the hymn tune in D minor over a soft harp, then strings swell up into the light}

sections.name: The Lamp Catches
sections.text: {the same hymn tune blooms in radiant D major on the warm lead over swelling strings and harp arpeggios}

sections.name: Fog Lifting
sections.text: {the hymn again, fuller, the bells singing the tune an octave up, gentle festive drums joining}

sections.name: Remembering
sections.text: {contrast: a tender turn to B minor and G major, slower and lower, remembering the eleven dark winters, then lifting on A major}

sections.name: The Lamp Catches Return
sections.text: {the radiant D major hymn returns in full; the last bar leads straight back into the melody}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
